sections.bodyString: Experience a new level of refreshment, hydration and flavor with Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water. Carbonated, clean and crisp, it’s the perfect beverage to satisfy your thirst that’s also caffeine-free, sodium-free and calorie-free. Plus, with a wide variety of flavors to choose from, you can always find the right flavor to suit your taste. Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water comes in Original, Black Cherry, Concord Grape, Cranberry Lime, Lemon Lime, Orange, Pink Grapefruit, Pomegranate, Raspberry Lime, and Strawberry Mango. Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water carries on the tradition established by Jacob Schweppe in 1783. Perfect all by itself, Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water is also great as a mixer for favorites drinks like Mojitos, Spritzers and Bahama Mamas. In fact, you can use Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water instead of plain water to give any of your favorite drinks a burst of effervescence and flavor! Reach for a Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water whenever you need refreshing hydration. With a wide assortment of flavorful options, you’re sure to find more than one favorite!

Enjoy the benefits of refreshment with Canada Dry Sparkling Seltzer Water. With carbonation that tickles your senses, bubbly flavor that brightens your spirit and refreshing taste that satisfies your thirst, Canada Dry is the ideal companion to take on your relaxation journey. For over 100 years, Canada Dry has been creating quality beverages and mixers to enjoy any time of day. Started in 1904 with Pale Ginger Ale, John J. McLaughlin created Canada Dry Ginger Ale as a lighter version of the syrupier ginger ales that were rising in popularity during that time. Today, there are so many more ways to enjoy the great taste of Canada Dry. Made with only the highest quality ingredients, you can enjoy the refreshing taste of Canada Dry Sparkling Seltzer Water in Original, Lemon Lime, Mandarin Orange, and Raspberry flavors. This crisp, bubbly seltzer water gives you the benefits of hydration that you would get from regular water with the taste of sparkling seltzer water. This 100% all-natural sparkling seltzer water also contains no calories, no sodium and no added sugar or sweeteners. You can make delicious cocktails or simply enjoy the taste on its own over ice.
